university.name: University of York
university.summary: A research-intensive university with its main campus at Heslington, York. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses across science, technology, law, business and the social sciences, and publishes a dedicated entry requirements page for applicants from Pakistan.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year degree covering programming, theory, systems and human-computer interaction in the first two years, with a final-year project and a choice of four option modules in areas such as machine learning, security and language processing.
highlights: Year 2 core: Intelligent Systems: Machine Learning and Optimisation
Year 2 core: Data: Introduction to Data Science
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA including Mathematics (AABB including Mathematics if studying a fourth A level). IB: 36 points overall, including 5 in Higher Level Mathematics or 6 in Standard Level Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic) 6.5 overall, with a minimum of 6.0 in each component. The page does not list PTE, TOEFL or Duolingo scores and refers to a separate IELTS equivalences page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with a Higher Secondary or Intermediate Certificate must first complete an additional course before applying: A levels, the International Baccalaureate or a recognised foundation course. No Pakistan percentage or CGPA is given for undergraduate entry.
courses.career_notes: Graduates mainly enter IT and computing, followed by financial services; some continue to further study such as a PhD.
courses.notes: The page metadata shows a typical offer range that differs from the AAA stated in the entry requirements; the stated AAA including Mathematics is used.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: A three-year law degree with core legal foundations in years one and two, optional modules in year two, and a final year combining a case study module with a dissertation or applied project or further options.
highlights: Year 1 core: Legal and Professional Skills
Year 2: two optional modules chosen, confirmed after the course begins
Year 3 core: one case study module, for example Corporate Commercial
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA. IB: 36 points. International foundation programme: Foundation Certificate from the York International Pathway College, or an appropriate alternative.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic) 6.5, with a minimum of 6.0 in each component. The page does not list PTE, TOEFL or Duolingo scores and refers to a separate IELTS equivalences page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with a Higher Secondary or Intermediate Certificate must first complete an additional course before applying: A levels, the International Baccalaureate or a recognised foundation course. No Pakistan percentage or CGPA is given for undergraduate entry.
courses.career_notes: The course page says the degree meets requirements that can enable progression towards qualification as a barrister or solicitor in England and Wales, and may count towards qualification in some other jurisdictions such as Malaysia.

courses.title: Mathematics
courses.overview: A three-year mathematics degree with a fixed first year, streams in pure, applied and probability and statistics in year two, and a largely optional final year including an extended independent project.
highlights: Year 1 core: Introduction to Probability and Statistics
Year 2 optional: Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, or Probability and Statistics streams (two chosen)
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: AAA including A in Mathematics (alternative AAB including A in Mathematics and A in Further Mathematics). IB: 36 points overall, including 6 in Higher Level Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic) 6.0 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with a Higher Secondary or Intermediate Certificate must first complete an additional course before applying: A levels, the International Baccalaureate or a recognised foundation course. No Pakistan percentage or CGPA is given for undergraduate entry.
courses.career_notes: Listed graduate roles include software developer, actuarial analyst, trainee accountant, teacher and data scientist. The page states the course is accredited by the Institute of Mathematics and its Applications.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in the Department of Computer Science covering machine learning, cloud-based data analysis and data governance, followed by an individual capstone project that runs from around April to September.
highlights: Core: Foundations of AI and Machine Learning
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree at 2:2 or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field, including modules in programming, mathematics and algorithms or data science.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic and Indicator) 6.5, minimum 6.0 in each component. PTE Academic 60 with 52 in Listening, 53 in Reading, 65 in Speaking and 59 in Writing. Duolingo 120, minimum 105 in all other components. TOEFL listed as 4.5, with 5 in Listening and 4.5 in each other component (as published).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate taught entry normally needs a four-year Bachelor's degree, typically the equivalent of a UK 2:2. It gives 60% (GPA 2.5 out of 4) as comparable to a UK 2:2 and 70% (GPA 2.8 out of 4) as comparable to a 2:1. A two- or three-year Bachelor's following an Associate Degree may also be accepted.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include software developer, information analyst, systems architect and business analyst, with progression to PhD study also mentioned.
courses.notes: Page title in search results is Data Science (MSc); the URL slug contains computational. Other York data science MSc variants exist and were not researched.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: A taught master's in law with one core module on legal systems and research methods, five option modules and a 12,000-word dissertation. The fee shown is for the one-year full-time route.
highlights: Core: Legal Systems and Research Methods
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree at 2:2 or equivalent in Law or a closely related subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic and Indicator) 6.5 overall, minimum 6.0 in each component. PTE Academic 60 with 52 in Listening, 53 in Reading, 65 in Speaking and 59 in Writing. Duolingo 120, minimum 105 in all other components. TOEFL listed as 4.5, with 5 in Listening and 4.5 in each other component (as published).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate taught entry normally needs a four-year Bachelor's degree, typically the equivalent of a UK 2:2. It gives 60% (GPA 2.5 out of 4) as comparable to a UK 2:2 and 70% (GPA 2.8 out of 4) as comparable to a 2:1. Pre-Masters courses are available through the International Pathway College.
courses.career_notes: The course page says the degree can support progression towards qualification as a barrister or solicitor in England and Wales and is recognised in some other jurisdictions.
courses.notes: Part-time fee is listed as 14,100 GBP per year over two years; not recorded as the main fee.

courses.title: Finance and Management
courses.overview: A one-year master's combining corporate finance, strategy and quantitative methods, with an individual research project of up to 8,000 words carried out over three months of the summer.
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree at 2.2 in a related subject such as Management, Economics, Finance, Accounting or Maths; other subjects may be accepted with some statistics content. Alternatively, three years of relevant senior managerial work experience or a professional qualification such as CFA Level 1 or ACCA.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic and Indicator) 6.5, minimum 6.0 in each component. PTE Academic 60 with 52 in Listening, 53 in Reading, 65 in Speaking and 59 in Writing. Duolingo 120, minimum 105 in all other components. TOEFL listed as 4.5, with 5 in Listening and 4.5 in each other component (as published).
courses.experience_requirements: Work-experience route: a minimum of three years of relevant senior managerial-level experience, or a relevant professional qualification such as CFA Level 1 or ACCA, for applicants who do not meet the degree requirement.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate taught entry normally needs a four-year Bachelor's degree, typically the equivalent of a UK 2:2. It gives 60% (GPA 2.5 out of 4) as comparable to a UK 2:2 and 70% (GPA 2.8 out of 4) as comparable to a 2:1.
courses.career_notes: The page lists financial consulting and general management roles, and mentions progression to doctoral study.
courses.notes: The fee table on the course page does not state a year; the page is for 2027/28 entry, so 2027/28 is recorded.

courses.title: Global Public Health Policy
courses.overview: A master's in public policy with a public health focus, taught through core modules on policy analysis, public management and global public health, and completed with an applied policy project. No optional modules are listed.
highlights: Core: Public Health Foundations and Practice
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree at 2:2 or equivalent. International applicants are directed to check equivalent qualifications for their country.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic and Indicator) 6.5 overall, minimum 6.0 in each component. PTE Academic 60 with 52 in Listening, 53 in Reading, 65 in Speaking and 59 in Writing. Duolingo 120, minimum 105 in all other components. TOEFL listed as 4.5, with 5 in Listening and 4.5 in each other component (as published).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate taught entry normally needs a four-year Bachelor's degree, typically the equivalent of a UK 2:2. It gives 60% (GPA 2.5 out of 4) as comparable to a UK 2:2 and 70% (GPA 2.8 out of 4) as comparable to a 2:1.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include policy analyst, public health consultant, policy advisor, international organisation officer and civil servant.
courses.notes: Field classification is a judgement: the award is a policy degree with a health focus. Fee shown is the full-time one-year fee.

scholarships.name: Global Impact Masters Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 for Pakistan, first year only (2026/27 terms; other countries receive GBP 5,000 or GBP 6,000)
scholarships.summary: A first-year award for full-time postgraduate taught students paying the overseas fee rate. Pakistan is in the highest band. Eligible students with a York offer are awarded automatically, with no separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time postgraduate taught course; overseas fee status; offer held by the set date; not fully sponsored or on a 100% tuition scholarship. Part-time, online, PGCert and research courses are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: The page shows the 2026/27 deadline (1 September 2026) and says scholarships for 2027 entry will open shortly. The 2027 deadline is not yet published.
scholarships.intake_label: September 2026 terms; 2027 entry terms not yet published
scholarships.notes: Terms seen are for the closed 2026/27 round. The York international funding page lists this award under previous opportunities. Do not present the amount as confirmed for 2027 entry.

scholarships.name: York Graduate Loyalty Discount
scholarships.summary: A 10% tuition discount for University of York undergraduate graduates (or former visiting students) who hold an offer for an eligible postgraduate taught course. It is assessed automatically within the application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Completed a York undergraduate degree or visiting study; holds an offer for an eligible postgraduate taught course. Excluded courses include MA Public Policy (Mundus MAPP), PGCE, MA Social Work, LLM Law (Juris Doctor) and the Graduate Diploma in Law.
scholarships.notes: Only relevant to applicants who already hold a York undergraduate degree.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarship (York as host university)
scholarships.provider_name: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission / UK FCDO, hosted by University of York
scholarships.value_text: Amount listed as various; York does not state a value
scholarships.summary: Awards for students from listed Commonwealth countries, including Pakistan, funded mostly by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office. Applicants apply through the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission portal; York is a host university.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applicant from an eligible Commonwealth country (Pakistan is listed); postgraduate taught or research study; awards fall under six development themes.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline on the York page; check the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission and FCDO scholarship search.
scholarships.notes: value_type left null because the York page gives no amount or coverage. This is an external government scheme, not a York award; confirm award terms on the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission site before publishing.
